description: Observed transit markets for the model's origin-destination checks (server/beta3/pipeline/od-checks.ts): who rides Muni (purpose, home county), how riders reach BART in the city, how many Muni boardings follow a change of vehicle, commute flows by means of transportation. Numbers are copied from the published sources; anything computed here is labeled derived.

sources.title: 2023-2024 Regional Transit Passenger Snapshot Survey dashboard (weekday)
sources.operator: MTC regional (Muni LR, Muni bus, BART, Caltrain shown)
sources.use: Muni light rail and bus riders: home county (San Francisco share) and trip purpose, weekday

sources.title: 2024 BART Station Profile Study (weekdays, primarily Tue-Thu; Apr-Dec 2024)

sampleSize.completedQuestionnaires: approximately 32,000 (bart.gov page); 31,998 in Origin Type systemwide row

sources.use: Share of entries at the eight city stations by riders setting out from home, and their access by "bus / transit" (Muni and other operators together), Sept-Nov 2024 Tue-Thu

sources.title: 2017 SFMTA Systemwide On-Board Survey - Draft Final Summary Report (ETC Institute for SFMTA/MTC), Nov 28 2017
sources.use: Changes of vehicle before boarding by Muni Metro line; KT origin and destination purposes; access and egress modes

sources.title: MTC Transit Passenger Survey route-level decomposition (decomposition/route_level_analysis.csv, BayAreaMetro/transit-passenger-surveys)
sources.sampleSize: weighted (expanded) records; unweighted n not in file
sources.use: Derived: share of Muni-intercepted linked trips with a BART or Caltrain leg before or after (before MTC's re-weighting)

sources.title: Caltrain Triennial Customer Survey - Fall 2025 Summary Report (with 2022 and 2019 comparisons)
sources.use: Share of Caltrain riders reaching or leaving the train by Muni

sources.title: CTPP 2017-2021 Part 2, Table B202105 Means of Transportation to Work (18), San Francisco County tracts
sources.use: Commuters to jobs in each tract of the city and their means of transportation

muni2017TransfersBeforeNote: Share of a line's boardings preceded by another bus or train (route charts: "how many buses/trains did you travel on before you boarded this one"); KT = the 2017 K-Ingleside/T-Third through line. "system" is derived from Table 8 (changes per one-way trip: 0 75%, 1 22%, 2 2%). MTC/RSG note local-bus surveys under-report changes to and from rail.

caltrain2025.note: all Caltrain riders, all stations (no station-level access by mode is published)

ctppWorkplace.source: CTPP 2017-2021 (5-year ACS), Part 2 (workplace) Table B202105, Means of Transportation to Work (18), workers 16 and over, every census tract of San Francisco County (summary level C31). AASHTO CTPP Data Portal query, downloaded without an account (under the 10,000-cell instant-download limit).
ctppWorkplace.note: transit = bus + subway or elevated rail + long-distance train or commuter rail + light rail, streetcar or trolley + ferryboat; drive = drove alone + all carpools; margins of error at 90% (transitMoe: root sum of squares, approximate)

inCommutersByPuma.source: ACS 2020-2024 5-year PUMS, California person file: workers with workplace San Francisco County (POWSP 006, POWPUMA 07500) by residence PUMA (2020 PUMAs) and means of transportation; commuters = workers less those working from home; standard errors from the 80 replicate weights (successive differences). Tabulated by data/beta3/raw/od/pums/puma_to_sf.py.
inCommutersByPuma.tractCentroidsNote: mean of the LODES 2023 crosswalk block points (blklatdd, blklondd) of each 2020 tract, with its 2020 PUMA (2020_Census_Tract_to_2020_PUMA.txt)

muni2017TransfersBeforeByOperator.note: Derived: the system share (muni2017TransfersBefore.system) split by the operator of the vehicle ridden just before the Muni boarding, in proportion to the expanded linked trips with that 'first before' leg in MTC's route-level decomposition of the 2017 Muni survey (mtc-tps-route-decomposition, weekday, SF Muni survey rows; legs with no operator left out). Compare: 704,412 expanded Muni boardings; 40,026 linked trips with a vehicle just before.

muni2017CrossSurveyLegs.note: Derived from MTC's route-level decomposition (weekday): expanded linked trips (each survey's linked-trip weights) with a leg on the other operator before or after the intercepted vehicle, as reported in each operator's own survey (Muni 2017, BART 2015, Caltrain 2014). A linked trip using both operators is split between the two surveys' weights, so the two halves should agree when neither survey under-reports the connection; the surveys are two to three years apart.
